description:
TAX LOT NO. 19 AND 20 IN BLOCK NO. 161
DIMENSION OF LOT APPROXIMATELY: 50.34 FEET X 90.42 FEET
NEAREST CROSS STREET: CENTRAL AVENUE (FKA CEDAR STREET)
ALL THAT CERTAIN LOT, PIECE OR PARCEL OF LAND, WITH THE BUILDINGS AND IMPROVEMENTS THEREON ERECTED, SITUATE, LYING AND BEING IN THE CITY OF UNION, COUNT OF HUDSON, STATE OF NEW JERSEY.
BEGINNING AT A POINT IN THE SOUTHERLY LINE OF 30TH STREET (FKA WALNUT STREET) (40 FEET WIDE), SAID POINT BEING DISTANT 121.69 FEET FROM THE INTERSECTION OF SAID LINE OF 30TH STREET, WITH THE EASTERLY LINE OF CENTRAL AVENUE (FKA CEDAR STREET) (50 FEET WIDE), THENCE FROM SAID BEGINNING POINT; RUNNING
1. ALONG THE SOUTHERLY LINE OF 30TH STREET, SOUTH 58 DEGREES 18 MINUTES 30 SECONDS EAST, 50.34 FEET, TO A POINT; THENCE
2. SOUTH 31 DEGREES 27 MINUTES 30 SECONDS WEST, 90.42 FEET TO A POINT; THENCE
3. NORTH 58 DEGREES 18 MINUTES 30 SECONDS WEST, 50.34 FEET, TO A POINT; THENCE
4. NORTH 31 DEGREES 27 MINUTES 30 SECONDS EAST, 90.42 FEET, TO THE POINT AND PLACE OF BEGINNING.
